headline: Trilegal, Khaitan & Co acts on Runwal Enterprises ₹500 crore IPO
sum: Runwal Enterprises Limited has launched an initial public offering aggregating to ~₹500 crore, comprising a fresh issue of 16,398,962 equity shares. Trilegal advised Runwal Enterprises on this IPO.
detail: Runwal Enterprises Limited has launched an initial public offering aggregating to ~₹500 crore, comprising a fresh issue of 16,398,962 equity shares. Trilegal advised Runwal Enterprises on this IPO. The transaction was led by Richa Choudhary (Partner) and Maitreya Rajurkar (Partner), with support from Pooja Tada (Senior Associate) and Associates Yug Gambhir, Siddhant Mishra, Samruddhi Varma, Shreyansh Gupta, and Arnab Goswami. Sai Krishna Bharathan (Partner) provided strategic inputs on the transaction.
